newsitem.title: PERU: Red Cross cannot confirm Peru radio call.
newsitem.headline: Red Cross cannot confirm Peru radio call.

text.p: The Red Cross said on Saturday it did not yet know if a call to a local radio station claiming all hostages in the Peru crisis would be freed on December 24 was authentic.
"We do not know if the call is authentic or not," Red Cross spokesman Roland Bigler told Reuters. "We are trying to establish if it is authentic."
The Peruvian police could not be reached for an immediate comment on the call because their switchboards were jammed with calls.

A man, claiming to be one of the guerrillas inside the Japanese ambassador's residence holding 340 hostages told a local radio station on air that the rebels had decided to release all their captives at 10 pm local time December 24 (0300 GMT December 25).
Bigler added that chief negotiator in the crisis, Red Cross official Michel Minnig, was not in the residence at the time of the call.
